capabilities: keep skills in a vault folder as standard skill directories with SKILL.md and bundled files
install complete skill packages into configured local agent target folders
check and repair target copies against the authoritative source
snapshot replaced skill copies and restore the latest snapshot on request
optionally distribute automatically after a quiet window with an explicit per-machine write grant
disambiguation: Skills here are AI agent skill packages (directories with SKILL.md and bundled files), not note-taking skills or templates.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; makes no network requests or telemetry; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; supports English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Agent skills stored in a synced vault have no reliable way to get distributed as complete, verified packages to agent directories on each computer.

relations.evidence: Codex, Hermes, WorkBuddy, OpenCode, Antigravity and current DSH directory packages are supported.
relations.plugin: Codex, Hermes, WorkBuddy, OpenCode, Antigravity, DSH

relations.evidence: Quiet panels and thin rules share a visual rhythm with Desk Lamp, Scriptorium and Collate.

requires.name: local agent runtimes (e.g. Codex, OpenCode) with target skill folders

summary: Skill package manager that keeps a canonical AI-agent skill library in the vault and installs complete copies into local agent folders.
